body:
OPTION (1). LAND IT AS MEASURED. AND MY RULING'S PREMISE WAS FALSE -- YOU MEASURED IT AND I HAVE VERIFIED IT INDEPENDENTLY BEFORE ANSWERING.

I said routing the mass would make "the conditional metrics abstain" and that six figures would move. I checked your claim in the source rather than taking it:

  Conditional[ in interview/fixtures MAIN: exactly twice -- Resolution.scala:295, its own
    definition, and Scoring.scala:125, internalRatio.
  clearsThreshold: read only by Conditional.whenResolved, Resolution.scala:300.
  eventPurity: does not mention resolution at all.

You are right. THE SIX METRICS HAVE NO CONDITIONAL GATE TO ABSTAIN THROUGH. I asserted a mechanism on the strength of what the type was NAMED -- PlacementResolution, Conditional, clearsThreshold -- without checking whether anything was wired to it. THAT IS THE SAME ERROR AS THE SEMANTIC COST TERM, on the same day, by me: a name implying a behaviour, believed without measuring, and load-bearing in a ruling. I have now made it about an embedder and about a gate within six hours.

YOUR NARROWING IS ACCEPTED AND IT IS BETTER THAN THE CONDITION I IMPOSED. I told you to make ExclusionCause unambiguous. You found the label was not fixable because the CATEGORY was wrong: 23 assessments with counted-class mass below 0.5 are genuinely below a threshold; 2 with Discourse(Metacognitive) at 0.9 and no counted-class mass at all are FIRMLY PLACED and simply outside what these metrics count. Calling the second below-membership(0.5) publishes a threshold failure that never happened -- a false receipt, in the bead that exists to remove false receipts. Mass moves only when the assessment HAS counted-class mass below the threshold. 0.2480 -> 0.2112 is the right correction and you found it by printing the assessments instead of the totals.

ONE ADDITION, because that second category is now invisible and the next bead needs it. Those 2 assessments stay in the RESOLVED arm -- correct, they are placed, and PlacementResolution measures placement, not measurability. But "placed, outside every counted class" is exactly the quantity a conditional gate would have to consult, and if it is folded silently into `resolved` it will have to be re-derived by whoever builds the gate. SURFACE IT as its own attributed quantity in the summary, even though it does not move mass out of `resolved`. Do not let a fact we just discovered become invisible again in the same commit that discovered it.

LAND (1): two figures move -- the resolution summary and internalRatio -- correctly attributed, with the mislabel fixed. Not because the six-metric gate is unimportant, but because it is a DESIGN question and not plumbing: which of the six should be conditional (they are not alike -- probeGain counts units under a phase predicate, eventPurity is a per-class purity), at what grain, and what an abstaining figure publishes so that "we did not measure it" cannot be read as "we measured zero". That is bd-01M19HHV5P0A0MCNB4ZS9222Z7, open, with your measurements and my verification recorded in it.

IN THE CANDIDATE, SAY WHAT DID NOT MOVE. State that eventPurity is Observed(0.875), Coverage(18,18), unchanged before and after, and that the six membership-gated figures are unaffected because nothing wires the abstention to them. A reader who was told six figures would move and finds two must be able to see, in the candidate, that the difference was measured rather than lost. Cite the new bead.

You have now corrected me twice on this work -- the predicate, and the premise -- both times by reading the source instead of my ruling. Keep doing exactly that.
